game.title: Binary Domain
game.blurb: Squad-based third-person shooter from SEGA (RAWG also lists Devil's Details), published by SEGA, released 2012-02-16. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the six campaign chapters counted in the Steam achievements, plus chapters drawn from achievement themes.

chapters.title: Campaign Chapters 1 to 3
chapters.summary: Clearing the first three campaign chapters. Their achievements are hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Chapters 4 to 6
chapters.summary: Clearing chapters four to six, plus three other hidden story achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Chases, Big Robots and Set Pieces
chapters.summary: The car chase and four hidden set-piece sequences, climbing onto the Grand Lancer's head, the Spider's legs, the mobile gun battery and the Iron Whale's engines.

chapters.title: Squad and Trust
chapters.summary: Taking every teammate along, buying them nanomachines, reviving them, and maximum trust with each of the six squad members.

chapters.title: Shops, Upgrades and SECURITY-COM
chapters.summary: Vending machines and shopping terminals, weapon upgrades, every nanomachine in one playthrough, and the SECURITY-COM collectibles.

chapters.title: Combat Bonuses
chapters.summary: Smash, multi-kill, headshot and one-shot bonuses, Assault Shooters and turning enemies on each other.

chapters.title: SURVIVOR and NO MERCY
chapters.summary: Clearing every chapter on the two harder modes.

chapters.title: Online Versus and INVASION
chapters.summary: Online versus wins with each rule set, INVASION stages, online level 50 and the online challenges.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 203750)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Binary_Domain
Fandom (binarydomain.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://binarydomain.fandom.com/wiki/Binary_Domain
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3965). The Steam store list has one matching app, 203750 ("Binary Domain"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp203750" (a placeholder name). StrategyWiki has "Binary Domain" at completion stage 0 (marked as a perfect stub article): only Controls (about 1,300 characters) and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay, Walkthrough and Achievements and trophies are linked but not written. binarydomain.fandom.com answers the API under "Binary Domain", but its only 3 links are trailer videos, so it says little. 19 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden. eTrophy_ID_Chapter1Clear to Chapter6Clear are the six chapter clears (their display names are in capitals, such as "HIT AND RUN"), so the campaign has six chapters; the split into two halves is our own choice. Four hidden achievements have API names starting eTrophy_ID_Minigame ("Seek and Destroy", "Water Slider", "Aquatic Chase", "Runaway Truck"), so they sit with the visible car chase ("Fugitive", also a Minigame API name) in the set-pieces chapter. The six hidden "Max Trust" achievements name the squad members Big Bo, Faye, Charlie, Rachael, Cain and Shindo and are in the squad chapter. The other three hidden ones, "A Private Moment" (25.3%), "Comrades in Arms" (24.3%) and "Big Bo Rescue" (6.9%), sit in Chapters 4 to 6 as a placeholder because their unlock rates are near or below the later chapter clears (27.9% to 26.1%), a guess.
